idea-plugin.name: CodeSonar
idea-plugin.description:
CodeSonar warnings in CLion, from a CodeSonar hub or an exported SARIF file. The work is done by the codesonar-lsp language server, which must be installed.
  • choose, show, hide and delete the analyses of the hub project
  • explain warnings with the events that lead to them and the rules they may violate
  • run codesonar analyze for the workspace, with the hub, project, presets and checks of its codesonar.conf
  • list the shown warnings and open them on the hub
